entry.description: Entry path within the installed package (relative to its node_modules root) used when embedding the package into a generated surface.

integrity.description: The package's sha512 dist.integrity. After `pi install` the installer compares the integrity npm recorded in pi's npm-root package-lock.json with this value and stops on a difference.

allowInstallScripts.description: The reviewed reason this companion needs its dependency lifecycle scripts. Absent: the install runs with npm_config_ignore_scripts=true.
